detailed_description: The Stacked Bar Chart Generator helps you show totals together with their component parts inside each category. It is a practical format when you need to compare both overall size and composition across teams, periods, channels, or segments. You can enter grouped values, tune stack order, colors, labels, and legend settings, then export the chart as PNG or SVG after reviewing the live preview in the browser.
usage_steps: Enter category labels and the values for each stacked segment in the editor.
Set the chart title and arrange the segment order to match the reading pattern you want.
Adjust colors, labels, and legend visibility so each section remains easy to distinguish.
Review the preview and refine the values or category names if the stacks feel crowded.
Export the completed stacked bar chart as PNG or SVG when the comparison is ready to share.
usage_examples: Compare quarterly revenue totals while showing the product mix inside each bar.
Present survey responses broken into answer groups for each department or region.
Track project effort by month with stacked bars for design, engineering, and QA work.
